Title: "Score: Find the Best Evidence"

1. "Index the help center": stack of articles labelled "31 help articles", arrow to small number-grid cards labelled "Meaning as numbers", arrow to a library icon labelled "In-memory search index". Tiny annotation "One document per article".

Bottom concise dashed takeaway: "Similar words help find candidates. Relevance decides which ones support the answer."
Ensure this remains spacious and legible; 5 stages may be equal width, with the worked example spanning whole width below. Do not show chunking, a cloud database, or team-based filtering.

Title: "The Complete ShopEasy Workflow"
Subtitle: "Jev makes decisions; the LLM writes the answer"
Compose a spacious branching flowchart with a clear main path from upper left to upper right, followed by a left-to-right answer pipeline in the lower half. Arrow direction is explicit; no backward or ambiguous connectors.
Upper flow:
1. Customer bubble "New message" → panel "Jev call 1".
Inside call 1, show two parallel tasks under one bracket: "3 Noul security checks" and "1 Choice team selection". Caption "Answered together".
Call 1 → decision diamond "Any attack score ≥ 0.5?"
Yes branch → coral stop card "Return a blocked response".
No branch → second diamond "Fraud / security team?"
Yes branch → person icon card "Return a fraud-handoff message".
No branch → connector labelled "Regular support question" into the lower answer pipeline.
